title: Vasto Prime
extract:
The Vasto Prime is the primed version of the  Vasto revolver, acting as a direct upgrade. It was released alongside  Nova Prime and  Soma Prime.
This weapon can be sold for  5,000; it is also a weapon crafting ingredient for  Akvasto Prime (x2).

Acquisition

Vaultings
On November 15, 2016, it was announced that the Vasto Prime, alongside  Nova Prime and  Soma Prime, would enter the Prime Vault and be retired from the reward tables. Any preexisting components or fully-built weapons will remain as is.
Vasto Prime, along with  Mag Prime,  Nova Prime,  Soma Prime,  Boar Prime, and  Dakra Prime, were unvaulted from November 13th, 2018 to January 29th, 2019.
From May 26th, 2020 to September 29th, 2020, Vasto Prime emerged from the Vault along with  Trinity Prime,  Nova Prime,  Dual Kamas Prime, and Soma Prime.

Notes

Incarnon Genesis

Upon completion of The Duviri Paradox and Angels of the Zariman, and unlocking The Steel Path, players can earn  Vasto Incarnon Genesis from The Circuit's Steel Path to place on their Vasto with the help of Cavalero in the Chrysalith. This Incarnon Genesis form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength.
Purchased from Cavalero for  120, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made once.

Installing the Vasto Incarnon Genesis requires 20  Pathos Clamps, 70  Yao Shrub, and 150  Saggen Pearl.
When installed, the first Evolution tier is unlocked. Each challenge additionally grants 5,000 affinity to the weapon, affected by Affinity Boosters.

Overview
Incarnon Form is charged by filling the Incarnon Transmutation gauge that appears under the reticle by achieving weakpoint hits and then pressing the Alternate Fire button. 8 weakpoints hits will completely fill the gauge. A full gauge is not required to activate Incarnon Form.
Charges do not generate on the backpacks of most MOA variants, or vulnerability spots generated by  Sonar or  Detect Vulnerability in places other than actual weakpoints.
Weakpoints on corpses or Invulnerable targets do not build charges.
Individual Multishot bullets can build charges.
Mode switching is not instantaneous and has an animation equal to the weapon's reload speed.
Swapping to and from Incarnon Form will fully reload the normal form's magazine.
Instead of drawing ammunition from its reserves, the Vasto's Incarnon Form uses a separate "magazine" with each charge producing 3 rounds to a maximum of 24. Once all ammunition is expended, the Vasto reverts to its normal form.
Incarnon Form's magazine is not affected by mods.
Incarnon Form is not affected by Ammo Efficiency (such as  Energized Munitions).
Charges and Incarnon Form persists through all activities, such as holstering, bleedout, or being disarmed. However, charges and Incarnon Form are removed upon death.

Evolutions

Tips
The Vasto Prime has a high chance of cutting corpses into pieces, making it ideal for a Desecrating  Nekros to bring along. The game considers corpses that have been bisected at the torso as separate entities, allowing Desecrate to convert both halves into individual chances for more drops.
Due to Vasto's incarnon form using the burst trigger, it cannot benefit from Semi-Pistol Cannonade.

Trivia
The Vasto Prime was one of the first Prime items which had colorable gold parts. This trait is shared with the  Soma Prime,  Nova Prime, Pyra Prime Syandana, and several other primes.
With the introduction of Damage 2.0, the original  Vasto, along with  Akvasto, became able to cut enemies into pieces due to its overwhelming slash damage. The Vasto Prime inherited this trait.
The Vasto Prime also bears a striking visual resemblance to the Enouy Revolver.
